import { expect, test } from "@playwright/test";
import { reseed } from "./support/seed";
import { sessionCookie } from "./support/session";

test.beforeAll(reseed);

test.beforeEach(async ({ context }) => {
  await context.addCookies([sessionCookie(1)]);
});

const PNG = Buffer.from(
  "",
  "base64",
);

test("editor image: empty, uploaded, and the screens that must not offer upload", async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/recipes/1/edit");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Kuva" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Reseptillä ei ole kuvaa.")).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: "review-shots/editor-empty.png", fullPage: false });

  await page.setInputFiles("#recipe-image", {
    name: "kaalilaatikko.png",
    mimeType: "image/png",
    buffer: PNG,
  });
  await page.locator(".recipe-image-editor form button[type=submit]").first().click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/recipes\/1\/edit$/);
  const img = page.locator(".recipe-image-editor img");
  await expect(img).toBeVisible();
  await expect(img).toHaveJSProperty("naturalWidth", 100);
  await expect(page.locator(".recipe-image-editor button.danger")).toBeVisible();
  await page.screenshot({ path: "review-shots/editor-image.png", fullPage: false });

  for (const [url, name] of [
    ["/recipes", "list"],
    ["/recipes/1", "detail"],
    ["/?week=2026-10-05", "week"],
  ] as const) {
    await page.goto(url);
    expect(await page.locator('input[type=file]').count(), `${name} has no file input`).toBe(0);
    expect(await page.locator('img').count(), `${name} shows no image`).toBe(0);
    await page.screenshot({ path: `review-shots/${name}.png`, fullPage: false });
  }
});

test("an oversized editor upload answers with raw JSON, not the editor", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/recipes/1/edit");
  await page.setInputFiles("#recipe-image", {
    name: "huge.png",
    mimeType: "image/png",
    buffer: Buffer.alloc(6 * 1024 * 1024, 1),
  });
  await page.locator(".recipe-image-editor form button[type=submit]").first().click();
  await page.waitForLoadState();
  await page.screenshot({ path: "review-shots/oversized.png", fullPage: false });
  expect(await page.content()).toContain("too large");
});

test("a realistically sized generated image overflows the phone layout", async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto("/recipes/1/edit");
  await page.setInputFiles("#recipe-image", {
    name: "wide.png",
    mimeType: "image/png",
    buffer: Buffer.from("", "base64"),
  });
  await page.locator(".recipe-image-editor form button[type=submit]").first().click();
  await page.waitForLoadState();
  const overflow = await page.evaluate(
    () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth - document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  );
  console.log("horizontal overflow px:", overflow);
  await page.screenshot({ path: "review-shots/wide-overflow.png", fullPage: false });
  expect(overflow).toBe(0);
});
